beat: Teacher/friend boundary, reputation fears and renewed trust

lines.original: Bantu: miss... but why you got angry... what if it was really nipples too...
lines.local: Bantu: Miss, lekin gussa kyun hui thi? Maan lo sach mein nipples dikh jaate toh bhi?

lines.original: Dhika was surprised that he would even ask it....
lines.local: Dhika hairaan hui ki woh aisa sawaal pooch sakta hai.

lines.original: Dhika: quietly.... how can you ask like that dear... I am your teacher... you cannot see me like that...
lines.local: Dhika dheere se: Dear, tum aise kaise pooch sakte ho? Main tumhari teacher hoon; tum mujhe aise nahi dekh sakte.

lines.original: Bantu: threading carefully now.... I know miss... but I am also your friend.... and it would have been just an accident...
lines.local: Bantu sambhalkar: Jaanta hoon miss, lekin main aapka friend bhi hoon. Aur woh bas ek accident hota.

lines.original: Dhika: I know...
lines.local: Dhika: Mujhe pata hai.

lines.original: Bantu: miss.. again, why did you became like that ?
lines.local: Bantu: Phir bhi miss, aap itni upset kyun ho gayi thi?

lines.original: Dhika: I got afraid....even if it would have been accidental...what if someone comes to know... what will happen to me....
lines.local: Dhika: Main darr gayi thi. Accident bhi hota, phir bhi kisi ko pata chal jaata toh mera kya hota?

lines.original: Bantu: miss... how will anyone else come to know....
lines.local: Bantu: Miss, kisi aur ko pata kaise chalega?

lines.original: Dhika: hmmmm she put her head down...
lines.local: Dhika: Hmmm... usne sir jhuka liya.

lines.original: Bantu: miss... you don't trust us ?
lines.local: Bantu: Miss, aapko hum par bharosa nahi hai?

lines.original: Dhika: I do dear... but still...
lines.local: Dhika: Hai dear... lekin phir bhi...

lines.original: Bantu: miss... you are our closest friend... we would never harm your name.... he bore a sad face...
lines.local: Bantu udaas chehra banakar: Miss, aap hamari sabse kareebi friend hain. Hum aapki badnaami kabhi nahi hone denge.

lines.original: Dhika:I know dear... smiling a little..
lines.local: Dhika thodi muskuraayi: Mujhe pata hai dear.

lines.original: Bantu: I trust you so much miss... If fact, Bobby and I even discussed that only you should accompany us to Swiss if we win...
lines.local: Bantu: Main aap par bahut trust karta hoon, miss. Bobby aur maine toh baat ki hai ki agar hum jeetein toh Switzerland mein aap hi hamare saath mentor bankar jaayein.

lines.original: Hearing that, she felt very honored and hugged him again...
lines.local: Yeh sunkar Dhika bahut honoured mehsoos karne lagi aur use dobara hug kiya.

lines.original: In the back of her mind... she thought how can she accompany them... not alone, I am not that mature to handle myself and them.. she remembered how she always felt dependent on John, which she even liked.....
lines.local: Dimaag ke kone mein usne socha—main in dono ko akele kaise le jaaungi? Shayad main khud ko aur inhe sambhalne jitni mature nahi; mujhe John par dependent rehna pasand hai.

lines.original: Anyway, she just pushed those thoughts away for now and released the hug....
lines.local: Filhaal usne yeh khayal hataaye aur hug chhod diya.

lines.original: Dhika: thank you dear... I will never get angry again towards you guys,.... I am so sorry...
lines.local: Dhika: Thank you dear. Main tum logon par dobara gussa nahi karungi... I am so sorry.

lines.original: Bantu: teasing a little... even if we see your nipples...
lines.local: Bantu thoda chhedte hue: Chahe hum aapke nipples dekh lein?

lines.original: Dhika: Snorted another laugh while wiping her tears away.... aiiiii... you are never seeing them... she pulled her tongue out...
lines.local: Dhika aansu ponchte hue hans padi—aiii, tum kabhi nahi dekhoge! Usne jeebh nikaal di.

lines.original: Bantu: uhnnnnn...... he put a puppy face...
lines.local: Bantu: Uhnnn... usne puppy-face bana liya.
